id.description: The request's id; empty when the device could not tie the result to one (an incomplete or unreadable message, a full queue).

result.description: Present with status ok: the operation's result, see <op>.result.json.

error.description: A short reason, with failed or busy (for example result-expired, result-too-large, queue-full, no-memory).

op.description: A signed result names the operation it answers (AUTHORITY.md section 3.4); absent when the request was not understood far enough to name one.

job_id.description: With op: the job id of the signed request it answers.

usig_boot.description: Signed results (AUTHORITY.md section 3.4): the boot epoch the signature counts in.

usig_seq.description: One counter for every signed message of this boot.

usig.description: Base64 Ed25519 by the node key over the object without this member; always the last member.

unsigned.description: Present instead of the three above when the device does not sign: the boot counter is unsaved or spent, or (rate) a refusal beyond the signing budget of 8 a second.
